PagerDuty: [Triggered] private-vpc-connectivity — customer=intellifin-prod — symptom=control-plane-unreachable — severity=P1 — https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PDT12345
incident-bot: Automated page fired to #incidents and on-call. Escalation policy: 0m -> oncall, 5m -> network, 10m -> infra.
Maya (oncall): Acked via PagerDuty. I'm taking this. Paging SRE + Network.
Javi (SRE): On standby. What's the observable impact? API errors? agent heartbeats?
Maya (oncall): Impact: Intellifin-prod (eu-west-1) private deployment. Control plane not reachable from their VPC. Customers report 502/504 on /v1/infer. Their agent heartbeats missing since 15:22Z. Customer ops confirms hitting 10.10.55.4:443 times out.
Ashley (Network): Can someone run traceroute to 10.10.55.4 from our eu-west egress? I'll also check perimeter firewall logs for their account id.
Ashley (Network): Running from eu-west-1a-egress...```
traceroute to 10.10.55.4 (10.10.55.4), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  1.1 ms  1.0 ms  1.0 ms
 2  100.64.0.5  2.0 ms  2.1 ms  2.0 ms
 3  * * *
 4  * * *
```
Ashley (Network): traceroute drops at transit gateway (hop 3).
Raj (Infra): I tried ssh to 10.10.55.4 from our jump. `ssh -i ~/.ssh/intellifin ops@10.10.55.4` just times out. Checked AWS route table for the transit attachment — route to 10.10.0.0/16 via tgw-abc is missing from rtb-rtb-03.
Raj (Infra): route table snapshot: ```
RouteTableId rtb-03
Destination 10.10.0.0/16 -> Target: none
Destination 0.0.0.0/0 -> Target: igw-0a
```
Javi (SRE): Check control plane agent endpoint: `curl -s -D - https://controlplane.internal.redwood/agents/intellifin-prod/heartbeat`
Javi (SRE): Response: ```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Date: Mon, 14 Mar 2026 15:24:12 GMT
```
Maya (oncall): Customer mentioned they made NIC changes earlier today. Possible NAT/firewall or route removal. @Ashley can you grep firewall for DENY entries to 10.10.55.4 at ~15:23Z?
Ashley (Network): Pulling logs... I see DENY entries from perimeter firewall for traffic sourced from our egress to 10.10.55.4 on tcp/443 at 2026-03-14T15:23:10Z. Policy: `deny-external-nat` matched. Snippet:
```
2026-03-14T15:23:10Z DENY src=54.72.10.11 dst=10.10.55.4 proto=TCP dport=443 rule_id=pol-998 deny-external-nat account=intellifin
```
Ashley (Network): Looks like a firewall policy change on their side (or an overly-broad rule applied to the transit path).
Raj (Infra): I can push a temporary more specific route via the transit gateway to restore reachability while we sort firewall rules. Want me to apply?
Maya (oncall): Yes, do it. Also prepare control plane fallback to public endpoint in case route patch doesn't stick. Javi, please prep the fallback job and customer comms.
Raj (Infra): Applying route replace: ```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-03 --destination-cidr-block 10.10.0.0/16 --transit-gateway-id tgw-abc
```
Raj (Infra): Route replace success. Ping to 10.10.55.4 now replies ~20ms.
Raj (Infra): Initiating agent restart from ops console (command queued).
Javi (SRE): Starting control plane fallback to public endpoint: ```
service control-plane set-fallback --customer intellifin-prod --to public-failover --reason "private connectivity loss"
```
incident-bot: Escalation timer running. If connectivity not restored in 5m, next escalation to network@pagerduty.
PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by Maya. Next escalation scheduled in 10m.
Maya (oncall): Customer ops reports heartbeats resumed and API errors reduced just after route patch. Monitoring for any regressions for 30m.
Javi (SRE): I'll take follow-up RCA and coordinate permchange with the customer. Handoff to me in 25m. I'll compile logs and the timeline into the postmortem.
Ashley (Network): Suggested permanent fix: add explicit ALLOW rule for 10.10.0.0/16 on perimeter firewall for the transit-gw source, and ensure route table has persistent route to tgw-abc. I'll open a PR for firewall policy change and tag @Maya / @Javi for review.
Maya (oncall): Notifying Intellifin: "We've applied a temporary route and restarted the agent; connectivity appears restored. Please verify traffic and restart any stalled jobs on your side. We'll follow up with an RCA and perm change."
Raj (Infra): :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Monitoring period started. Degradation cleared at 2026-03-14T15:31:00Z per synthetic checks. If no regressions, we'll move to post-incident review.
Maya (oncall): Closing page in 30m if stable. Handover note to Javi for RCA and customer follow-up.
